reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the shared getScheduledAmount, the same function the forecast, schedules app and budget template use, so the API cannot drift from Actual's rule.

duplication.why: No logic is re-implemented; the field is one call to the existing helper.

placement.why: The list handler in api.ts adds the field on top of scheduleModel.toExternal and a dedicated APIScheduleListEntity type keeps it out of create/update; computing it in the api-models mapping would also have been reasonable.

scope.why: Only the list handler, its result type and the existing API test expectations change.

maintainability.why: Small, typed and delegating to the single definition of the expected amount.
